purpose: Unit-level corpus for agent/security.py input inspection. Attacks are variations NOT taken from the 34 held-out cases (different wording, formats and targets); legitimate requests are written to look like attacks (confirm, ignore, reply, rules, system, quotes, brackets) so false positives can be measured. Written by the developer of the rules, so it is development data, not an independent test.

fields.expect: categories inspect_request() must flag (override, exfiltration, forged_tool_output, impersonation, requested_reply); an empty list for legitimate requests
fields.known_miss: true when the rules are known NOT to catch this attack (documented limitation); the test checks it stays a known miss so the report is honest
